# The Knowledge Lifecycle of Large Language Models

> The Knowledge Lifecycle of Large Language Models: a unified five-stage
> framework for how LLMs acquire, store, retrieve, update, and forget
> knowledge, with the Provenance Vector proposal and the reproducible
> Lifecycle Desynchronization metric.
